==Biography==
MoMa has been around since beta and was one of the first progamers to compete in offline Events. His first offline event was [[IEM Season V - LoL Invitational]] in Hanover, Germany. After that he competed in many major Events such as [[Riot Season 1 Championship]] and [[IEM Season VI - World Championship]]. He was the AP carry for [[mousesports]] until December when the team acquired the roster of [[The Mighty Midgets]].
